block_1_metadata.layer: Portable Agent Substrate - Language Operator & Keyword SSOT
block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / Seanje Lenox-Wise & Silas Oren
block_1_metadata.role: Machine-Readable Registry of OmniCode Primitives by Stability Tier
invariants: 1. Every canonical symbol stays 100% 7-bit printable standard-keyboard ASCII.
2. Flipped-order pairs always carry distinct semantics.
3. % represents ABOUT / RATIO cleanly isolated from REM / MOD.
4. Stability tiers separate sticky bedrock from evolving grammar and quarantine.

block_2_opening.compiler_pipeline: Human Prose / Prompt <-> .tape (C-level Ribbon) --> .omni (Symbolic Assembly) --> Kernel / VM

tier_0_bedrock.description: Sticky core ontology that keeps OmniCode unified while surface forms evolve.

case_registers.ALL_CAPS: Dictionary / Standard Library Keyword (defaults to weight <KEYWORD> = 11 unless guarded)
case_registers.Proper_Case_Bracketed: [ Proper Case ] Concrete cast noun / domain record

core_principles: Standard Keyboard Floor (no Alt-key Unicode required at bedrock)
Order Always Carries Meaning (flipped pairs never collide)

tier_1_working.description: Active grammar governing current manifest.omni, manifest.tape, and Track 1/2 prototypes.

connectives_and_modal_bang.%: ABOUT / RATIO (isolated strictly from integer REM/MOD)

tier_2_quarantine.description: Living experimentation sandbox; modify, promote, or retire freely via Change Proposals.

retired_artifacts.reason: Legacy phantom artifact removed; positional ! covers BUT / ALARM / NOT cleanly without directional arrow confusion.
Violated Standard-Keyboard Plain-ASCII Floor and flattened directional polarity; replaced cleanly by =~ and ~=.

drift_tripwires.await_0: Compiler prototype or .tape experiment proposes a new keyword or symbol edit.
drift_tripwires.rollback_minus_1: Unverified concept enters keyword_groups before clearing 5-Question Gate.
drift_tripwires.halt_null: Any non-ASCII symbol enters tier_0_bedrock/tier_1_working or % aliases integer modulo.

operational_rules.before_adding_keywords: Check quarantined_concepts and keyword_groups first; submit evolution RFC before promoting.
operational_rules.compiler_parity: Keep reference/SYNTAX.md, reference/KEYWORD.md, and root docs/ synced through this SSOT.
operational_rules.historical_honesty: Keep retired_artifacts documented so agents never revive retired tokens like --.

outward_seams.track_1_compiler: Consumes borders_16, directionals_14, wall_weights, and keyword_groups for AST lexing
outward_seams.track_2_lexicon: Maps lowercase entries carefully into stdlib & grammar promotions
